topic: Asset handling for facility box migration
summary_markdown:
The conversation addressed the procedure for managing assets when a physical 'facility box' is updated or migrated. It was decided that only assets derived from new data should be retained; old assets linked to the decommissioned boxes must be deleted, while all other unrelated assets remain untouched.

[me] reported an incident (an 'accident') causing delays in work and noted that real-time analytics would not function for certain facilities on that day. Later, [me] confirmed attempting fixes but noted that some facility boxes had not yet been successfully migrated or transferred.
decisions: Only assets based on new data should be saved/retained.
Old assets linked to the decommissioned facility boxes must be deleted.
Other unrelated assets should remain untouched.
action_items: Complete the migration of all remaining facility boxes.
